summary: Completed comprehensive testing of d+p | compugrafic landing page. All backend APIs working correctly (12/12 tests passed). Frontend functionality working well with both sections, toggle switches, navigation, and contact form. Minor mobile navigation layout issue identified.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigation links wrap and overlap with location text on mobile viewport (390px). Links are cramped and text overlaps.

issues: Navigation links wrap to multiple lines and overlap with hero content on small screens

passed_tests: API root endpoint returns correct message
Contact form submission for Compugrafic section
Contact form submission for D+P section
Contact form submission without optional empresa field
Contact form validation for missing required fields (returns 422)
Contact form validation for invalid email format (returns 422)
GET /api/contact returns list of contacts
Contact data structure is correct
Contact persistence after create
Default section is compugrafic
D+P section explicit assignment works
Homepage loads with hero section and 4 service cards
Toggle switch between Compugrafic and D+P via header logo buttons
Toggle switch between sections via floating toggle

Navbar links scroll to correct sections in D+P (NOSOTROS, MISIÓN Y VISIÓN, METODOLOGÍA, PROYECTOS, CONTACTO)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All core functionality working. Backend uses EmailStr for email validation (fixed from previous iteration). Contact form sends to different emails based on section (ventas@compugrafic.com for Compugrafic, dmasp.ventas@compugrafic.com for D+P). Web3Forms integration is configured with key in backend .env. Mobile navigation could use improvement but is functional.
